prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Create exactly ONE finished, flat typographic poster, portrait 2:3 ratio, opaque pure white background.
Original user request (authoritative): 덕테이프 포스터로 '숨과 숨 사이'를 5장 만들어줘. 검은 글자와 흰 여백만 써줘. 문구는 한 번만 넣고, 그림·도형·테두리·구분선·질감·장식 기호·추가 문구는 넣지 마. 줄바꿈은 어절 사이에서만 해도 좋아.
This call produces only the single assigned direction, not five posters or a contact sheet.
Exact printed copy, once: "숨과 숨 사이"
The three intact word groups are "숨과", "숨", "사이", in precisely that left-to-right order. Preserve all syllables and the two original occurrences of 숨. No other text anywhere.
Art direction: The three word groups move through white space from left to right on gently rising baselines, making a single reading walk. Use solid black, clean, carefully proportioned Korean sans-serif lettering with intact normal Hangul structures and open counters. All three word groups have the same optical type size and black weight. The first group sits toward the left near the middle height; the second group sits near the center and slightly higher; the final group sits toward the right and slightly higher again. Their position and baseline relationship is the composition. Keep the word groups fully inside the frame with generous margins. Give real blank white gaps between groups so the phrase breathes, but let the three groups read as one left-to-right passage rather than disconnected captions or three vertical rows. The rise should be modest, about one character height in total. Allocate most of the white field above and below this central passage. Each Korean character should be large enough that the whole phrase remains recognizable in thumbnail view, roughly one tenth of the poster width in height. Do not stretch, horizontally compress, break apart, or ornament the letters. Carefully align each word's internal baseline and regular natural syllable spacing.
Mandatory conditions: black lettering and pure flat white background only; one instance of the full supplied phrase; no picture, icon, abstract shape, frame, border, divider, texture, decorative symbol, logo, watermark, additional copy, punctuation, or microtext. Word breaks may occur only between the three intact words. Do not turn Hangul strokes into drawings. Do not add gray material effects, paper grain, shadows, gradients or mockup surroundings. Crisp normal antialiasing at the edges of solid black glyphs is acceptable; no other visual elements.
요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력

FINAL TARGETED EDIT: Use the supplied immediate parent poster as the edit target. Keep the exact three complete black Korean word groups, their shapes and optical weight, their size and generous word gaps, their same gently rising positions, the full left-to-right reading, and the portrait 2:3 composition.
The remaining defect is a faint diagonal grain in every blank white region and a very light parallel gray fringe just below some horizontal glyph edges. Remove both defects. Do not preserve or reproduce the background surface pixels: redraw the entire empty field as one clean, computer-flat, pure #FFFFFF solid color with no physical material whatsoever. There must be zero diagonal streaks, grain, noise, paper texture, shading, gradients, vignette, colored tint, scan texture, rough print, blur, or embossing anywhere in the white field. Remove all gray parallel duplicate fringe lines beneath the glyph strokes. The lettering is simply solid pure #000000 black on pure #FFFFFF white, with minimal necessary crisp edge antialiasing and no shadow, glow, edge doubling, bevel, halo, surface noise, or ghosting. This is a flat digital typographic poster; no photographed or scanned surface exists. Keep the background fully opaque. No new element or text may be added. The authoritative original user request, exact copy and all mandatory constraints above continue to apply.
